# R packages used

A variety of R packages was used for this analysis.  All graphics and data wrangling were handled using the [tidyverse suite of packages](https://www.tidyverse.org/).  All packages used are available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN), Bioconductor.org, or Github.  

***

# IJOQ

## Data preparation

```{r IJOQ data prep}
IJOQ <- read_csv('fig3_IJOQ_res.csv')

IJOQ$inf <- as.factor(IJOQ$inf) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('NI', 'I'))

IJOQ$analyte <- as.factor(IJOQ$analyte) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('E-cadherin','ZO-1'))

IJOQ$model <- as.factor(IJOQ$model) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('HCT-8', 'hALI'))
```

## Statistics

```{r IJOQ statistics - Shapiro}
IJOQ_shapiro <- group_by(IJOQ, inf, analyte, model) %>%
  shapiro_test(IJOQ)

datatable(IJOQ_shapiro)
```

```{r IJOQ statistics - Wilcoxon}
IJOQ_wilcoxon <-
  group_by(IJOQ, analyte, model) %>% 
  wilcox_test(IJOQ~inf) %>%
  add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position(x = 'analyte') 

datatable(IJOQ_wilcoxon)
```

## Plot

```{r IJOQ Plot}
IJOQ_plot <- ggbarplot(
  IJOQ,
  'analyte',
  'IJOQ',
  color = 'black',
  fill = 'inf',
  facet.by = c('model'),
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  add.params = list(
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'inf',
    jitter = .02
  ),
  xlab = FALSE,
  ylab = 'IJOQ',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 8)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'none',
        x.text.angle = 0) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    IJOQ_wilcoxon,
    label = 'p.signif',
    tip.length = 0.03,
    hide.ns = F,
    remove.bracket = F,
    bracket.nudge.y = .003,
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c(
    'No infection',
    expression(paste(italic('C. parvum')))),
    palette = 'Paired'
  )

print(IJOQ_plot)
```

***

# TEER

## Data preparation

```{r TEER data prep}
TEER <-
  read.csv(file = 'fig3_TEER_res.csv', stringsAsFactors = F)

TEER$time <- as.factor(TEER$time) %>%
  factor(levels = c('4', '24'))

TEER$condition <- as.factor(TEER$condition) %>%
  factor(levels = c('No infection', 'C. parvum', 'C. hominis'))

TEER$model <- as.factor(TEER$model) %>%
  factor(levels = c("HCT-8", "hALI"))
```

## Statistics

```{r TEER statistics - Shapiro}
TEER_shapiro <- TEER %>%
  group_by(model, condition, time) %>% 
  shapiro_test(adjust_TEER)

datatable(TEER_shapiro)
```
```{r TEER statistics - Kruskal}
TEER_kruskal <- TEER %>%
  group_by(time, model) %>%
  kruskal_test(adjust_TEER ~ condition)

datatable(TEER_kruskal)
```
```{r TEER statistics - Dunn}
TEER_dunn <- TEER %>%
  group_by(time, model) %>%
  dunn_test(adjust_TEER ~ condition) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = 'time', dodge = .85)

datatable(TEER_dunn)
```

## Plot

```{r TEER plot}
TEER_plot <- ggbarplot(
  TEER,
  'time',
  'adjust_TEER',
  fill = 'condition',
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  facet.by = "model",
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'condition',
    width = .3,
    jitter = .1
  ),
  xlab = FALSE,
  ylab = 'TEER (Ω.cm2)',
  legend.title = '',
  # title = 'TEER in hALI infected with Cp or Ch (E68 + E69)',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 8)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = "top") +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c("No infection",
                               expression(italic("C. parvum")),
                               expression(italic('C. hominis'))
                               ),
                    palette = 'Paired')


TEER_plot <- TEER_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    TEER_dunn,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = T,
    bracket.nudge.y = -.1,
    step.group.by = 'time'
  )

print(TEER_plot)
```

# Dextran

## Data preparation

```{r dextran data prep}
dextran <-
  read.csv(file = 'fig3_dextran_res.csv', stringsAsFactors = F)

dextran$time <- as.factor(dextran$time) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('4', '24'))

dextran$condition <- as.factor(dextran$condition) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('No infection', 'C. parvum', 'C. hominis'))

dextran$model <- as.factor(dextran$model) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('HCT-8', 'hALI'))
```
 ## Statistics
 
```{r dextran statistics - Shapiro}
dextran_shapiro <- dextran %>%
  group_by(model, condition, time) %>% 
  shapiro_test(mean_conc)

datatable(dextran_shapiro)
```
```{r dextran statistics - Kruskal}
dextran_kruskal <- dextran %>%
  group_by(time, model) %>%
  kruskal_test(mean_conc ~ condition)

datatable(dextran_kruskal)
```
```{r dextran statistics - Dunn}
dextran_dunn <- dextran %>%
  group_by(time, model) %>%
  dunn_test(mean_conc ~ condition) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = 'time', dodge = .85)

datatable(dextran_dunn)
```
```{r dextran plot}
dextran_plot <- ggbarplot(
  dextran,
  'time',
  'mean_conc',
  fill = 'condition',
  color = 'black',
  facet.by = 'model',
  palette = brewer.pal(5, 'Paired'),
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'condition',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  xlab = 'Time post-infection (h)',
  ylab = 'Dextran concentration (mg/l)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 8)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'none')

dextran_plot <- dextran_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    dextran_dunn,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = T,
    step.group.by = 'time'
  )

print(dextran_plot)
```

***

# Figure building

```{r fig building}
(TEER_plot + plot_spacer()) /
(dextran_plot + IJOQ_plot)
```
